package.name: san_formation
package.description:
SAN v1.5 — 9 Formations + Hungarian slot assignment (SDD-SWARM §7). Publishes SlotAssignment, FollowerTargetMessage (KPP-1, KPP-3), FormationStatus per IDS-CMD v1.5 §4.2/§5.1/§5.9.
PATCH 2026-05-13 (Formation deep-dive review): * Added formation_planner library — pure-logic frame transform, velocity estimator, 1-second slot prediction (SDD §6.3 / PDR-3) * Patched formations.cpp — Box / Diamond ring-out 4-way symmetric * Patched formation_node.cpp — leader-anchored frame, listener- outside-lock, v1.5 9-formation ID support (was clamped to v1.3 0..4), velocity-driven 1-s prediction (was zero-vel) * Test coverage: 16 existing + 8 PATCH validation = 24 testcases
